bounded_host_request.command:
p=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai
v=0
cid=$(docker compose --project-directory "$p" -f "$p/compose.yaml" ps -q sandbox-runner) || exit 40
test -n "$cid" || v=$((v+1))
if test -n "$cid"; then
  docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$cid" | grep -qx true || v=$((v+2))
  created=$(docker inspect -f '{{.Created}}' "$cid" | cut -c1-19)
  test "$created" '>' 2026-10-16T22:35:00 || v=$((v+4))
fi
docker compose --project-directory "$p" -f "$p/compose.yaml" config --services >/dev/null || v=$((v+8))
exit "$v"
